items.title: Qoder 排队机制与账号风控说明
items.body: 部分 Qoder 账号请求出现持续排队（底层返回 10605）。官方证实此为调用触发的账号级风控惩罚（慢速队列）。订阅套餐享有专属优先通道；遇到排队时，10Router 会自动识别并冷却顺延至其他可用账号。
items.titleEn: Qoder queue throttle and account rate-limit explained
items.bodyEn: Some Qoder accounts have experienced continuous queue waiting ('Estimated wait time ~1 min', upstream code 10605). According to official responses, this is a targeted rate-limit applied to accounts with high-frequency access patterns. Subscribed accounts enjoy prioritized lanes; 10Router automatically detects code 10605 and fails over to other accounts.

items.title: Loomy 模型池收紧：三款下线，新增 MiMo V2.5
items.body: 讯飞收紧模型池：Qwen 3.8 Max / MiniMax M3 / Kimi K2.6 下线不可调（组合引用了它们的请更新成员）；新增 MiMo V2.5（全模态，×3.3）。各模型积分倍率已标注在模型行（Spark-X2.6 正式版限时免费 ×0.0）。多账号的邀请码可在 CreditDaddy 快速填写与获取。
items.titleEn: Loomy model pool tightened: 3 models retired, MiMo V2.5 added
items.bodyEn: iFlytek tightened the pool: Qwen 3.8 Max / MiniMax M3 / Kimi K2.6 are retired (update combos referencing them); MiMo V2.5 added (omni-modal, x3.3). Credit multipliers are now labeled on model rows (Spark-X2.6 official is free for a limited time, x0.0). Invite codes for multiple accounts can be quickly filled/obtained via CreditDaddy.

items.title: 媒体提供商 → 音乐：直接生成整首歌
items.body: 侧栏新增「音乐」分类。ACE Music 托管版 ACE-Step 出整曲 MP3，StepFun StepAudio 3 Music 限时免费——一行描述自动写词，多行文字直接当歌词唱。示例卡内建播放器与下载按钮，模型、连接、Prompt 现场切换直接试。
items.titleEn: Media providers → Music: generate full songs
items.bodyEn: A new Music category in the sidebar. ACE Music (hosted ACE-Step) returns a full MP3; StepFun StepAudio 3 Music is free for a limited time — one line of description gets lyrics written for you, multi-line text is sung as-is. The example card has a built-in player and download button.

items.title: 多套风格化新主题上线（含 Glass 毛玻璃）
items.body: 右上角调色板新增 Gruvbox、Nord、Dracula 极客主题与 Glass（深/浅毛玻璃质感）；支持独立设置跟随系统偏好，全局暗色与品牌对比度全面优化。
items.titleEn: New themes: Gruvbox, Nord, Dracula & Glass
items.bodyEn: Added Gruvbox, Nord, Dracula themes and Glass (dark/light frosted blur effect) to the theme selector. Supports independent follow-system preferences with enhanced dark-mode contrast.

items.title: 讯飞 Loomy 免费池：8 个模型，短信直登
items.body: 免费额度区块原生收录，手机验证码直登换 14 天会话，无需装客户端；高峰期偏慢属正常。
items.titleEn: iFlytek Loomy free pool: 8 models via SMS login
items.bodyEn: Built into the free-tier section — phone SMS code signs a 14-day session, no client needed. Slower at peak hours.

items.title: 调度变更：到期包优先烧 + 双窗健康度
items.body: 资产包严格按到期压榨；订阅账号任一窗口见底即交接；429 冷却上限 24 小时。
items.bodyEn: Asset packs burn soonest-expiring first; subscription accounts hand over when either window bottoms out; 429 cooldown capped at 24h.

items.title: Antigravity 按家族隔离配额
items.body: Gemini 与 Claude/GPT 配额独立核算、独立选号；风控账号标红并附验证链接。
items.bodyEn: Gemini vs Claude/GPT quotas tracked and selected independently; risk-flagged accounts go red with a verify link.

items.title: 代理变更：不可直连渠道默认严格模式
items.body: 代理失败立即报错接力，不再回退直连死等（曾实测 788 秒）。
items.titleEn: Proxy change: direct-connect channels default to strict
items.bodyEn: Proxy failures now error immediately and relay instead of hanging on blocked direct connections (788s seen).

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 收录
items.body: Gemini 4 Argon 三线接入（1M 上下文）；Codex 新增 GPT-6.1 Sol（Responses Lite 协议）。
items.bodyEn: Gemini 4 Argon across three lanes (1M context); Codex adds GPT-6.1 Sol over Responses Lite.
